key_scoring.notes: The key (8 h, CDK peak) is defensible as the time of maximal CDK activity. But "most likely to enter mitosis" is ambiguous: the CDK activity rises steeply at 5-7 h, and entry into mitosis occurs as CDK activity becomes high, not necessarily at the moment of the peak.
